A nearest-neighbor coarse segment that meets a selected whole coarse cell has an endpoint in it. If one instead lifted the continuous complement incidently, crossing fine bonds would occur in both sets, preventing that independent-variable interpretation. Do not claim this contradicts the source: it distinguishes readings of overloaded notation. The prior boundary-overlap falsifier is unchanged.
